confirmedPreexistingIssue.description: The compensated keyboard width extends outside its landscape grid column when centered, crossing the adjacent answer-board column.
confirmedPreexistingIssue.limits: These are bounding-rectangle intersections, not a claim that every point inside rounded cell corners intercepted a tap.

rootCorrection: In the existing short landscape rule, .race-gameplay > .keyboard now uses justify-self: start. This retains compensated target width while aligning expansion away from the adjacent board in either text direction.
